def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace in text columns and normalize label variants
    for c in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
        df[c] = df[c].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'nan': None})
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.capitalize()
    # ensure numeric columns are numeric
    for c in ['bill_length_mm','bill_depth_mm','flipper_length_mm','body_mass_g','year']:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    # fix out-of-range body mass (unit error: grams written as milligrams-scale)
    bad = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[bad, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[bad, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    # any remaining out-of-range values are unreliable -> treat as missing
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
